import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/training_3.csv"
]

# List to hold the 'attributes' columns from each source
attributes_list = []

# Load each source CSV, extract the 'attributes' column, drop NaNs, and collect
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Extract 'attributes' column, drop NaN values
    attrs = df['attributes'].dropna()
    attributes_list.append(attrs)

# Concatenate all attributes from all sources into a single Series
all_attributes = pd.concat(attributes_list, ignore_index=True)

# Remove duplicates and reset index
all_attributes_unique = all_attributes.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

# Create the target DataFrame with the single column 'attributes'
target_df = pd.DataFrame({'attributes': all_attributes_unique})

# Save the result to the specified target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
